definition: a tall sea tower whose light guides ships
description: A girl sits on a train next to a poster of a red-and-white striped lighthouse taped to the partition and draws a circle around it with a marker, then rests her chin on her hands and looks at it. She is then standing on a grassy clifftop at sunset, holding the poster up towards the real lighthouse, and finally turns to look up at the tall red-and-white tower with the sun setting over the sea behind it.
